description_en: Replaces a FILE resource in a specified enterprise knowledge base and triggers re-parsing
description_zh: 用于替换指定的企业知识库中的FILE资源并触发重新解析
name: ReplaceKnowledgeBaseSourceFile

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. In winnexo-cli, pass this parameter explicitly by using --tenant-id
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；winnexo-cli 通过 --tenant-id 显式传入
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the FILE data source in the enterprise knowledge base to be replaced
parameters.help_zh: 待替换的企业知识库 FILE 数据源 ID
parameters.name: source_id

parameters.help_en: The OSS persistent storage address of the replacement file
parameters.help_zh: 替换后的文件 OSS 持久化地址
parameters.name: file_path

parameters.help_en: The public access URL of the new file. The URL may contain a temporary signature
parameters.help_zh: 新文件的公开访问URL（可能携带临时签名）
parameters.name: file_public_url

parameters.help_en: The file record ID of the replacement file
parameters.help_zh: 替换后的文件记录 ID
parameters.name: file_record_id

parameters.help_en: The new file name. This parameter is optional. If this parameter is not provided or set to an empty string, the original file name is retained
parameters.help_zh: 新文件名（可选；不传或空字符串时保持原文件名）
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to synchronously wait for re-parsing to complete. Default value: false, which indicates asynchronous queuing
parameters.help_zh: 是否同步等待重新解析完成；默认 false，异步入队
parameters.name: force_sync

200.description_en: 替换企业知识库资源文件并重新解析
200.description_zh: 替换企业知识库资源文件并重新解析

schema.description_en: The response for replacing an enterprise knowledge base resource file and triggering re-parsing
schema.description_zh: 替换企业知识库资源文件并重新解析

filePath.description_en: The OSS persistent storage address of the replacement file
filePath.description_zh: 替换后的文件 OSS 持久化地址

filePublicUrl.description_en: The OSS persistent storage address of the replacement file
filePublicUrl.description_zh: 替换后的文件 OSS 持久化地址

fileRecordId.description_en: The file record ID of the replacement file
fileRecordId.description_zh: 替换后的文件记录 ID

message.description_en: The description of the status code

status.description_en: The task status. The value Running is returned upon submission
status.description_zh: 任务状态：提交即返回 Running
